description: Every outbound call the Ever Platform modules of a product can make, one row per purpose. tools/sync-contract.mjs stamps x-ever-row on each operation of contracts/openapi/ever-platform.v1.yaml and fails when a selected operation has no row or a row names a missing operation; tools/generate.mjs renders docs/outbound-calls.md and contracts/generated/outbound-calls.json from it. `errors` lists the (status, code) pairs each row documents; a third element `spec-gap` marks a pair the mock implements before the platform contract documents that status for the operation. Rows marked `pending_upstream` have no operation in the platform contract yet: their bodies live in pending-upstream.json.

groups.session: Keys, tokens, heartbeat, entitlements and notices
groups.integration: Integrations, each with its own consent and scope
groups.receipt: Receipts for a person's deletion or export request

rows.title: Key manifest
rows.trigger: first signature verification; every 24 h; an unknown key id
rows.payload: none (read)
rows.cadence: at most every 24 h; at most once per 10 min on an unknown key id

rows.title: Legal texts
rows.trigger: connect or link
rows.payload: none (read: links to the terms, the data-processing agreement and the sub-processor list)

rows.title: Redeem a connect code
rows.trigger: the operator submits a connect code; EVER_CONNECT_CODE at first boot
rows.payload: code, product, version, install_source, kind (self_hosted; cloud on deployments Ever operates), serves_products[], public_jwk (the connect key), tenant {product_tenant_id, product_org_id?, display_name}? (absent values are omitted, never sent as null); never the installation's address

rows.title: Instance token
rows.auth: client assertion signed with the connect key
rows.trigger: while connected: before the token expires, and after a 401
rows.payload: grant_type, client_assertion_type, client_assertion (issuer and subject are the Ever Platform instance id returned at connect, never the statistics instance id)
rows.cadence: every 50 min while connected; on a 401

rows.title: Tenant links
rows.trigger: an organization admin submits a link code, removes a link, or a single-organization product moves its link to a new organization id
rows.payload: link_code, product, product_tenant_id, product_org_id?, display_name? of the tenant

rows.title: Heartbeat and instance status
rows.trigger: while connected; the status read also while an approval is pending and when an admin opens the connection page
rows.payload: version, module_version?, serves_products[]? (heartbeat); none (status read)
rows.cadence: within 5 min of boot, then every 24 h

rows.title: Event feed
rows.trigger: while connected
rows.payload: cursor only
rows.cadence: continuous long-poll (wait=25), or one read every 15 min with EVER_CONNECT_FEED_MODE=interval

rows.title: Entitlement documents
rows.trigger: while connected: every 6 h, at boot, on an entitlement notice, on demand
rows.payload: none (read; If-None-Match with the cached sequence number)
rows.cadence: every 6 h; on boot; on a change notice; on demand

rows.title: Integration states and consent links
rows.trigger: after a consent notice; on return from app.ever.co; when an admin opens the integrations tab
rows.payload: integration, link, return (query)

rows.title: Disable an integration locally
rows.trigger: an admin disables an integration locally; an operator policy denies it
rows.payload: enabled: false, reason (instance or policy), tenant_link_id?
rows.disable: none needed: this call only ever disables

rows.title: Link statistics to the organization
rows.trigger: integration stats_link enabled (self-hosted installations only)
rows.payload: stats_instance_id, stats_public_jwk, statement_sig: a statement signed with the separate statistics key, sent under the connect-key token, so app.ever.co can show the installation's last report
rows.cadence: once; again after Reset instance identity

rows.title: Discoverable identifiers
rows.trigger: the organization opted in to being discoverable in app.ever.co; its identifiers change; it opts out
rows.payload: hashes[{kind, salt_version, hash}] of the organization's own tax id, registration number and billing e-mail
rows.cadence: on opt-in, on change, on opt-out

rows.title: Counterparty lookup
rows.auth: none (salt and test vectors); instance token and Ever-Link-Id (lookup)
rows.trigger: daily salt refresh; a user clicks Check on Ever Platform on a contact
rows.payload: salt_version, hashes[at most 100] of a contact's tax id, registration number or e-mail
rows.cadence: on click, and one salt read a day

rows.title: Ever ID sign-in client
rows.trigger: integration ever_id_login enabled; then a status read until the client is ready
rows.payload: redirect_uri, logout_uri (the sign-in callback and back-channel logout addresses); the answer carries the client id and, once, the client secret
rows.cadence: once per installation (one client serves every linked organization), then a read every few seconds until ready
rows.disable: disable ever_id_login (the client is removed on the Ever Platform side)

rows.title: App mirror
rows.trigger: integration app_sync enabled and an app or deployment changes; nightly reconciliation
rows.payload: app and deployment identifiers, kind, status, deployment {target, provider, shape, managed_by, url}, organization id; member joined or left (ids only)
rows.cadence: every 30 s when there is something to send; nightly

rows.title: Disconnect and connect-key rotation
rows.trigger: the operator disconnects; the connect key is rotated
rows.payload: none (disconnect); public_jwk of the new connect key (rotation; the statistics key is never rotated by this call)

rows.title: Anonymous usage statistics report
rows.auth: none: the body is signed with the statistics key carried in the signature headers
rows.trigger: statistics module loaded and enabled
rows.payload: the ever.stats.v1 document: statistics instance id, product, version, channel, install source, coarse country, month, allow-listed counts, feature flags and integer aggregates
rows.cadence: once a day at a jittered time; at boot when the last send is older than 24 h; a final re-send of the previous month on days 1-3

rows.title: Installation address
rows.trigger: integration instance_url enabled in app.ever.co by the organization that owns the connection and accepted by the operator; revoked
rows.payload: base_url (the installation's public address)
rows.cadence: once; again when the address changes
rows.disable: disable instance_url (the address is removed from Ever Platform)

rows.title: Person links
rows.trigger: a user of the installation links or unlinks Ever ID; a one-time sync of links that existed before the installation connected
rows.payload: product_user_ref (the product's user id), identity_issuer, identity_subject, link_method, product_tenant_id?, product_org_id?, tenant_link_id?, display_name? of the tenant; never an e-mail or a person's name

rows.title: Receipt for a deletion or export request
rows.trigger: a deletion or export request for a person arrived on the event feed and was handled
rows.payload: job_id, result (deleted, anonymised, retained_legal, no_account, forwarded_to_controller, exported or failed), optional non-identifying detail

rows.title: Import into public profile
rows.trigger: an admin clicks Import into public profile
rows.payload: the declared public-profile fields only (name, website, short description, logo address, country)

rows.title: Identity resolution
rows.trigger: a backend that holds only an Ever ID token needs the Ever Platform context of that sign-in
rows.payload: issuer, subject, id_token?

rows.title: Signed-in person's context
rows.auth: the person's Ever ID token received at sign-in (read-only; answers only for organizations linked to this installation)
rows.trigger: an Ever ID sign-in whose token lacks the Ever Platform claims
rows.payload: none (read)

rows.title: Company sign-in discovery
rows.trigger: a user picks Sign in with your company
rows.payload: email_domain (a domain, never an address)

rows.title: Cloud billing link
rows.trigger: integration billing_link enabled (installations Ever operates only)
rows.payload: product_tenant_id, the payment customer reference of the linked tenant

rows.title: Complete a provisioning hand-off
rows.trigger: a provisioning hand-off the person confirmed on a product screen
rows.payload: instance_id, product_tenant_id, product_org_id?, product_user_ref?, urls?, result, refusal_reason?

rows.title: Usage reports
rows.trigger: integration usage_reporting enabled (on under the cloud terms on Ever Cloud; off on self-hosted installations unless an admin consents)
rows.payload: the consented meters only (counts, never names or ids of people)

rows.title: Install status
rows.trigger: an install request picked from apps.ever.co was handled by the installation's plugin installer
rows.payload: state, detail? (a fixed token), external_ref?

rows.title: Device-first connect
rows.auth: none (device start); device code and client assertion (token poll)
rows.trigger: the operator chooses Show a code instead
rows.payload: product, version, install_source, kind, serves_products[], public_jwk (start); device_code, client_assertion (poll)
rows.cadence: once, then a poll at the interval the platform answers until approved or expired

rows.title: Webhook endpoint
rows.trigger: integration webhooks enabled on an installation that can receive requests; the operator manages its endpoint
rows.payload: url (the installation's own callback address), event_filter[]

rows.title: Operator accepts an installation-wide integration
rows.trigger: the operator accepts or declines an installation-wide integration that waits for the local accept
rows.payload: consent_id, accepted

rows.title: Provider access grants
rows.trigger: a provider access notice arrived on the event feed and was handled
rows.payload: none (read of the grant); grant_id, status, product_user_ref (status report)

rows.title: In-product consent
rows.auth: the person's Ever ID token from a fresh sign-in through this installation's own client (auth_time at most 300 s old)
rows.trigger: an organization owner or admin confirms the in-product consent dialog after a fresh Ever ID sign-in
rows.payload: enabled, tenant_link_id?, consent {scope_version, dpa_version, accepted, screen_version?, ui_locale?}
rows.disable: never offered for instance_url and counterparty_discoverable; without an Ever ID client the product links to app.ever.co instead

rows.title: Managed operation result
rows.trigger: the product's executor finished an operation an owner or admin requested, with the managed_operations integration consented and the operator's local opt-in
rows.payload: status, version?, artefact_ref?, size_bytes? (status and size only; never backup content, file names or customer data)
rows.disable: disable managed_operations, or leave the local opt-in off
